name: Jackpot Hunter

features.name: Trail game
features.description: Spin a wheel to move along a 41-space map.

review:
A 20-line jungle adventure on 5x4 with backpacks, maps and dinosaurs. Compass wilds help wins, and there are two bonuses: three wheel symbols start a trail game, three Aztec scatters start free spins.

The trail is a 41-space board where you get five spins of a 1–8 wheel to move along, collecting prizes – a nice break from standard free spins. Up to 5,000x, 96% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
